critical_code_review_comments: MyWallet.jsx L122: title uses optional-chained items[0]; good. Minor: if order.items ever contains null product_name (defensive), string becomes 'undefined · ...' — low priority to add fallback.

MyWallet.jsx L80 Sheet onOpenChange: passing `onClose` (no-arg) to Radix which calls it with boolean `open`. Works today because TxRow unmounts via `open && <TxDetailSheet/>` guard, so onOpenChange(true) first-mount is prevented. Still a minor smell — recommend `onOpenChange={(v)=>!v&&onClose()}` for clarity.
server.py get_wallet (L728): per-request `async for` iteration over the orders cursor is fine; `.to_list()` would be slightly more idiomatic but both work.

context_for_next_testing_agent: get_wallet enriches payment txs by joining db.orders on tx.ref (order_id) and projecting items[{product_name, spec_label, quantity, image}]; topup/admin_* txs have no `order`. TxRow title formula: `${items[0].product_name}${spec_label?' · '+spec_label:''}${items.length>1?' 等N件':''}` with '購買' tag when items exist; falls back to parsed note. TxDetailSheet (Radix bottom sheet with #FFF4EA bg + dot pattern) renders tx-detail-items card only when t.order?.items?.length>0; '查看訂單' Link routes to /orders. AccountLayout mobile nav uses flex row + overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar with w-1/5 flex-none items — 5 per screen, scroll reveals 幫助中心 + 登出帳戶 (7 total).
